name: Malaysian Vegetable Curry
steps: Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces of similar thickness. Check the curry powder label to ensure it is vegetarian; bruise the lemongrass with the back of a knife.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Cook onion for 5 minutes, then add ginger and lemongrass for 1 minute. Stir in curry powder and turmeric with a splash of water and fry 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add potatoes, carrots and 300 ml water. Cover and simmer 10 minutes so the firm vegetables start to soften before the quicker-cooking ones go in.

Pour in coconut milk and add aubergine, cabbage and long beans. Simmer uncovered 10–12 minutes until everything is tender but the beans still have some bite. Add tofu puffs for the final 5 minutes to absorb the sauce.
Remove the lemongrass, add salt and lime juice, and rest 5 minutes. Serve the fragrant coconut curry with steamed rice.
tips: Use a clearly labelled vegetarian curry powder or paste. Add tender vegetables later so they do not turn mushy.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
